pages.title: Stable Ecosystem
pages.text: A sealed world in balance: producers, grazers and hunters whose numbers rise and fall around each other without ever crashing or exploding. The fifth piece of the Tree of Life. It dies if carried about too long. Made in the Ecosphere.
